note: Recommendations carry evidence coverage, never a fabricated confidence percentage. Every material input is named, and what is unresolved is named too.

recommendations.statement: Do not sign a California lease yet.

material_inputs.why: Work location and level follow from the role, and the role is not settled.
Move-in cash must be sized before committing to a lease.
The $3,200 target is a planning placeholder, not live inventory.
Employer support changes what Lane must front at signing.

recommendations.conclusion_rule: Supported while any material input is unresolved or the authorization gate is unmet. A deferral is strengthened by missing evidence; an action would be weakened by it.
